63e6f40e-caad-4452-be54-7c4484d72bfe.quote: Physical armor is the clearest adjustment. Skylar, Drongo and Yurei are physical and accounted for half of Grux's deaths, while the only defensive item answers magic. Swapping Tainted Rounds for a physical armor item gives up anti-heal and some on-hit damage; that is a fair trade here because Nerb's Tainted Scepter and Muriel's Sentinel passive also reduce enemy healing.
63e6f40e-caad-4452-be54-7c4484d72bfe.issue: circular anti-heal logic: Nerb's read waives Tainted Scepter because Grux has Tainted Rounds, and Tainted Scepter only came online as Nerb's last item; Tainted Rounds was the earliest anti-heal item against Yurei and Sevarog
63e6f40e-caad-4452-be54-7c4484d72bfe.rewrite: Physical armor is the clearest adjustment. Skylar, Drongo and Yurei are physical and accounted for half of Grux's deaths, while the only defensive item answers magic. Tainted Rounds is not the slot to cut: it was Grux's first item and the team's earliest anti-heal item against Yurei's and Sevarog's healing, while Nerb's Tainted Scepter came last. If armor goes in, it replaces a later damage item such as Augmentation, trading some on-hit damage and haste for surviving the physical follow-up.

63e6f40e-caad-4452-be54-7c4484d72bfe.quote: Satariel grants Fearless stacks on takedowns that raise power and attack speed while lowering max health, and death removes them.
